# Lisbet Brinhollow

Lisbet Brinhollow is a Battery Dispatch Engineer at Zordra Robotics, where she focuses on optimizing grid-scale battery output to adapt to fluctuating power demand and maximize both lifespan and revenue. At Zordra, she contributes to the FluxCore project—a sophisticated automation platform that dynamically manages battery dispatch decisions across multiple interconnection points, balancing degradation modeling with market signals.

Lisbet joined Zordra Robotics in early 2021 following an impactful tenure at VoltStor Inc., where she worked from 2015 to 2020. At VoltStor, she was instrumental in leading the real-time dispatch software upgrade dubbed Project VectorShift. This initiative enhanced VoltStor’s ability to respond to rapid changes in grid demand and incorporated novel predictive degradation algorithms. Project VectorShift improved battery cycle efficiency by an estimated 15% and reduced unexpected wear events by over 20% during its first year of deployment.

Her expertise lies at the intersection of control algorithms, predictive modeling, and grid market integration. She has a particular specialty in developing software that coordinates battery assets within crowded interconnection queues, ensuring seamless dispatch decisions that account for both technical constraints and market economics. Lisbet has worked extensively with grid operators, software developers, and integration engineers to test and refine these systems in live environments.

Notable projects at Zordra include FluxCore’s “Adaptive Pulse” module, which uses machine learning to dynamically adjust charge-discharge patterns based on short-term demand forecasts and degradation risk. Lisbet collaborates closely with data scientists who provide advanced forecasting models, as well as product managers who align technical capabilities with customer needs in utility-scale deployments.

Lisbet is known for a collaborative and iterative working style, favoring frequent cross-disciplinary feedback sessions to refine algorithms and user interfaces. Her approach emphasizes transparency and modularity, which has helped accelerate FluxCore’s development roadmap by nearly six months compared to initial projections. She regularly mentors junior engineers on best practices for integrating hardware constraints into dispatch software.

In summary, Lisbet Brinhollow combines deep technical knowledge with practical project leadership to advance grid-scale battery dispatch technologies, positioning Zordra Robotics as a leader in automated battery lifecycle optimization.
